statement: The management board submits the approved annual report to the commercial register within six months after the end of the financial year, together with the profit-distribution or loss-covering proposal and, where auditing is compulsory, the sworn auditor's report (Commercial Code § 179(4)). The financial year is twelve months and defaults to the calendar year unless the articles of association provide otherwise (Accounting Act § 13).
caveat: Where the shareholders have not passed a resolution approving the report, the unapproved report is submitted with a notation to that effect. The registrar may fine a legal person repeatedly, without a warning order, until an overdue report is filed, and persistent failure is a ground for compulsory dissolution (Commercial Register Act §§ 57, 58).
